findings.issue: Path traversal protection: first check (Path(filename).name != filename) catches OS path separators; second check (is_relative_to) catches symlinks or other edge cases. Ordering is correct — the early reject prevents any file system interaction for obviously malicious filenames.
findings.suggestion: No change required. Two-layer defense is correct and complete.

findings.issue: json.loads(content) on user-uploaded bytes is safe — no code execution risk. Extremely large files could cause memory pressure, but for criteria files (expected <100KB) this is not a concern.
findings.suggestion: No change required for this use case.
